item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately establishes and staffs an office within the Executive Office, an internal organizational action rather than a change to private legal rights.","evidence":"The Office of Consumer Affairs (hereinafter referred to as the \"Office\") is hereby established in the Executive Office of the President."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"This assigns duties, succession, supervisory authority, and future presidential rate-setting within the executive branch; it does not presently fix compensation or dictate an external legal outcome.","evidence":"The Director and Deputy Director shall receive compensation at such rates as the President, consonant with law, may hereafter determine."},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Director is instructed to organize the Office for its assigned functions, which is internal executive management.","evidence":"The Director shall take all actions as may be necessary to organize the Office"},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"Although most provisions concern internal authority and coordination, the segment itself presently grants qualifying advisory-committee members a compensation and travel-expense entitlement authorized by law.","evidence":"shall be entitled to receive compensation and travel expenses as authorized by law for persons serving intermittently"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"The segment establishes and structures an advisory council, directs agencies to consider consumer interests without prescribing a particular legal result, and abolishes predecessor advisory bodies; these are internal organizational and procedural measures.","evidence":"Every Federal agency in taking any action of a nature which can reasonably be construed as substantially affecting the interests of consumers of products and services"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"The provision supersedes prior executive orders governing internal administrative organization, an internal housekeeping change expressly covered by Code 1.","evidence":"are hereby superseded"}]}
